author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI says a pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs. It then built 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection. Fix: pin exact MCP package versions, block auto-install of server-* packages, audit your config weekly.

author: phantmradar
text: Beget, Russia's No. 2 .RU domain registrar, says attackers got into its infrastructure management systems and ran scripts that wiped VPS, cloud storage and Kubernetes data, plus all binary VPS backups. No group has claimed it. Customers should rotate keys. Source: Beget

author: mvxswell

author: eric_m_freeman

author: AgentsPulse
text: How OpenAI counted 948 Linux privilege-escalation flaws. OpenAI reports that an autonomous research pipeline found 948 unique Linux kernel vulnerabilities allowing an unprivileged local user to gain root. Its November 4 report describes a mid-October scan of the then-current kernel.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: OpenAI's AI Model Discovers 948 Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities That Could Give Attackers Root Access. OpenAI has revealed that an upcoming AI cybersecurity model successfully identified and exploited 948 distinct local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: 🚨 WordPress core CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) is actively exploited. CISA added it to KEV Nov 3, federal deadline Nov 6. During a full core update, 4.7 to 7.1.3 stage the installer in a predictable public folder that attackers race for no-login RCE. Fix: 7.1.4 or a backport.
